'''Skijid Vrescot''' was a [[J'feh/Legends|J'feh]] crime lord as well as the appointed [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]]. He had purchased [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] from [[Doffen Gaitag]] of [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] for the sole purpose of opening a vast distribution network for [[Tirefin]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. As such, he had also had the recycling systems of the station to refine the tirefin spice to maximum potency. However, his reign ended up short lived due to the dangerous line of work of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealing, when he made the error of ensuring that the [[Glottalphib]] [[Pirate/Legends|piratess]] [[Kliskud]] had free reign in attacking [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that came onto territory in exchange for driving out rival spice gangs, resulting in driving away even potential high-stakes customers. Their partnership came to an end, although it resulted in Vrescot being eaten by Kliskud.<ref name="Vegas" />
